checks.label: Sleeping object count
checks.description: Number of objects in the player's sleeping list.

checks.label: Combined resources
checks.description: Sum of food, wood, stone and gold, truncating each resource to an integer first. The check does not distinguish the four resources.

checks.label: Object types
checks.description: Sum of the master/type IDs of live objects.

checks.label: Object states
checks.description: Sum of the state bytes of live objects.

checks.label: Resources held by objects
checks.description: Sum of live objects' held amounts, truncating each amount to an integer first.

checks.label: Waypoint placeholder
checks.description: Reserved ObjectWaypoints word. This build leaves it at zero; it is not a comparison of waypoint contents.

checks.label: Live object count
checks.description: Number of objects in the player's live list.

checks.label: Object positions
checks.description: Sum of all three position coordinates of live objects, multiplying each coordinate by 100 and truncating to an integer first.

checks.label: Player ID
checks.description: Player identifier for this checkpoint lane.

checks.label: Actions and unit AI
checks.description: Sum of live objects' top action types, action state bytes and unit-AI retarget timers.

checks.label: Object IDs
checks.description: Sum of the IDs of live objects.
